responsibility: This implementation module wraps the UnixArgs argc/argv hooks to return command-line arguments as DynamicStrings.String values. It computes the selected argv entry address directly from the C-style vector, converts it with InitStringCharStar, and reports the argument count from GetArgC, making it the String-oriented companion to the array-copying Args implementation.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SArgs pair: unlike SArgs.def, it directly reads argc/argv through UnixArgs, computes the selected argv slot from C-style pointers, and builds the returned DynamicStrings.String values.
